label: Any startup (common spine)
about: Milestones every founder in Tamil Nadu goes through, whatever the product. Domain packs add to these and can replace them by id.

templates.title: Define the product and who pays for it
deliverables: What the buyer uses today instead
templates.why: Every roadmap starts by pinning the product and the buyer.

templates.title: Talk to 20 potential buyers
templates.why: Validates demand before money is spent.

templates.title: Check the brand name and file a trademark
deliverables: Trademark application in the right class
templates.why: A name you cannot protect is a name you may lose after building it.

templates.title: Choose the business entity and register it
deliverables: Entity choice: proprietorship, LLP or private limited
Incorporation through MCA (SPICe+) for LLP or company
PAN, TAN and a current account
templates.why: Licences, bank loans and DPIIT recognition all need a legal entity; DPIIT recognition needs a private limited company, LLP or registered partnership.

templates.title: Business registrations

deliverables.text: DPIIT startup recognition (needs a private limited company, LLP or registered partnership)

templates.why: Udyam unlocks MSME schemes and collateral-free loans; GST, DPIIT and StartupTN are added only when your answers need them (GST threshold for goods in Tamil Nadu: ₹40 lakh — verify).

templates.title: Licences and approvals for your product
templates.why: The approvals your product's domain needs, each with its source and how sure we are.

templates.title: Pilot with real buyers
templates.why: Turns interest into evidence before scaling spend.

templates.title: Apply for seed grants
templates.why: Your funding route is grants; Vanigam's catalogue shows which are open now.

templates.title: Raise a scheme-linked bank loan
deliverables: Loan application at the matched branch
templates.why: Your funding route is debt; the bank-routing engine picks the scheme and branch.

templates.title: Raise from angels
templates.why: Your funding route is equity; raise after pilot evidence exists.

templates.title: First 100 paying customers
templates.why: The proof every later step depends on.

templates.title: Scale what works
templates.why: Growth after the unit economics are known.
